# Ohio HVAC Pros

## About
Ohio HVAC Pros connects homeowners and businesses across all 88 Ohio counties with licensed, bonded, and insured HVAC contractors. We match customers with vetted local professionals for heating, cooling, and indoor air quality work. Free quotes on every job, no obligation to book.

## Services
- Air Conditioning Installation (central AC, ductless mini-splits, whole-home cooling)
- Furnace Repair (gas furnace diagnostics and repair, 24/7 availability)
- Furnace Installation and Replacement
- Heat Pump Installation and Service
- HVAC System Tune-Ups and Preventive Maintenance
- Ductwork Repair and Replacement
- Indoor Air Quality (air purifiers, humidifiers, UV systems)
- Emergency HVAC Service (heating and cooling failures)
- Commercial HVAC (light commercial and multi-unit properties)

## Service Area
All 88 Ohio counties including Columbus, Cleveland, Cincinnati, Toledo, Akron, Dayton, Youngstown, Canton, Parma, Lorain, Hamilton, Springfield, Kettering, Elyria, Lakewood, Cuyahoga Falls, Euclid, Middletown, Newark, Mansfield, and surrounding communities statewide.

## Why Choose Us
Every contractor in our network is independently verified for license, bonding, and insurance before being listed. We cover all 88 Ohio counties, so customers in rural areas have the same access to qualified contractors as those in Columbus or Cleveland. Free quotes mean you can compare pricing before committing to any work.
